integrity.proof_scope: all indicated fixed r, n>=2, and stated triangular local regimes; infinite-sample statements proved analytically

scientific_limitations: Only the complete-data scalar U-statistic with a fully specified U(0,1) null is analyzed.
The fixed-alternative power statement uses the standard asymptotic normal cutoff, not exact finite-n critical values.
No result is claimed for censoring-adjusted tests, estimated endpoints, or the integrated-squared beta-characterization statistic.
Historical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Monotone blind alternatives and a quarter-power detection boundary for a uniformity U-statistic
